description: Solve an hCaptcha and return the token. Waits up to wait_seconds; if the solve is still running then, returns its id and status: call get_solve with the id rather than solving again. Only successful solves are charged.

proxy.description: Proxy to solve through, as a URL: scheme://user:pass@host:port (http, https, socks5, socks5h or socks4).

rqdata.description: Enterprise only: the rqdata the site passes to its widget, if it passes one.

sitekey.description: The hCaptcha sitekey on the page.

url.description: The URL of the page the captcha is on.

user_agent.description: The user agent of the browser that loaded the page, as is. Leave out if you do not have it.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result, 0-50. Default 45. 0 returns right after submitting.

name: solve_hcaptcha
title: Solve an hCaptcha
